summary: [standards] Rewrite operand moves regardless of removed-option order. Reproduced: canon subject adopt --change-id add-login --subject-id demo --json emits a hint containing --change add-login --subject-id demo; executing that exact hint exits 2 again for removed --subject-id. find only performs the operand move when the first hit has operand=true, and renamed excludes all operand rows. Apply every collected transformation while retaining the first hit for attribution; test both orders. Blast radius: adopt/unadopt and any leaf mixing renamed flags with older operand moves.
